title: HANDLE, LOCK & GUIDE PIN
summary: Door outside handle (the push-button handle at the top rear of the door), the key lock cylinder, the door latch (lock assembly) with its shield, the rod linking the handle to the latch, and the guide pin at the rear of the door. The outside handle bolts on from inside the door with nuts on its two studs over a seal; the key cylinder goes in through a gasket and is held from inside by a slide-on retainer clip; the latch and shield are screwed to the rear of the door, and the guide pin is held by a nut from inside.

parts.name: ROD ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Rod assembly – outside handle to lock

parts.name: LOCK UNIT
parts.name_expanded: Lock unit – door key cylinder (includes key)

fastening.to: door outer panel, handle opening at the top of the door
fastening.qty: 2 studs on the handle; 1 nut called out
fastening.note: Handle asm. [12] drops in from outside with its two studs through seal [11]; nut [7] goes on a stud from inside the door.
Seal [11] sits between the handle [12] flange and the door panel.

fastening.to: door outer panel, lock cylinder hole
fastening.note: View A: lock unit [9] goes in from outside through gasket [8]; U-shaped retainer [10] slides onto the cylinder from inside the door.
View A: gasket [8] between lock cylinder [9] and the panel.

fastening.to: rear (lock pillar) end of the door, near the top
fastening.note: Guide pin [1] stud goes through the door from outside; nut [13] goes on from inside (dashed line from [1] to [13]).
Two screws [2]: one goes into the upper rear face of the door beside the guide-pin area, one through the tab of shield [3].

fastening.to: door rear end, lower part of the lock
fastening.note: Screw [4] goes in at the lower end of lock asm. [5].

fastening.to: outside handle lever and lock release lever
fastening.note: Rod asm. [6] links the outside handle [12] to the lock [5]; threaded pin at the lower end goes into the lock lever (adjust per procedure).

notes: DOOR LOCK ADJ. PROCEDURE Adjust the threaded pin on the lower end of rod asm. to provide full travel of the handle in the outside door handle housing.
NOTE The outside release lever on the side door lock asm. is not to be pre-engaged with the release mechanism in the lock.
